adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and applies it directly to `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound and no `> 0` validation. This makes the public `/groups/:group_id/members` endpoint susceptible to very large limits (returning an arbitrarily large member list for any visible group, including large automatic groups) and allows `limit=0`, which then propagates to the client model (`result.meta.limit`) and is used as a divisor in `currentPage`/`totalPages` (`Math.floor(... / this.get('limit'))`), producing invalid pagination behavior (Infinity/NaN / stuck paging).
